- They want the unused pilot allowance ($8,200) applied as an invoice offset on 2026-10-20 instead of a standalone credit memo.
- They also want a 14-day trial extension (new end date 2026-11-13).
- Finance wants a brief accounting note / GL reference for audit.

1) post a contra-invoice (invoice offset) using GLA 4105 and create a tied accounting note, or

Laura / Naomi — accounting guidance below. TL;DR: invoice offset is fine but we need to record a contra-invoice and an internal journal entry so audit can trace the movement.

Suggested treatment:
- Post an invoice offset (negative line) on the 2026-10-20 billing batch referencing original pilot allowance (deal RD-OR-2026-0911).
- Use GLA 4105 (Sales Allowances) for the offset line.
- Create an internal memo (accounting_handback_note.xlsx) indicating: original promotional allowance, unused balance $8,200, method = invoice offset, JE to move from Promo Suspense (GLA 2740) to Sales Allowances (GLA 4105) on the posting date.
- Keep a copy of signed pilot_agreement_signed.pdf in the supporting docs folder.

If we go credit-memo route instead, accounting prefers the same GLA but will expect a separate credit memo number and reconciliation entry. For Orbis I recommend invoice offset (less touch and preserves their AR workflow).

I attached a draft accounting note and a template for the external invoice remark. Use this wording on the invoice: "Promotional allowance applied per pilot agreement RD-OR-2026-0911; net reduction $8,200."

- Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Accounting | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodai.com
Attachments: accounting_handback_note.xlsx, credit_memo_template.pdf

We can accommodate both requests. Summary and ask:
